segments.text: I compared U S D C lending with a Treasury bill fund. Under base cost assumptions, ten thousand dollars earned just fifty-eight to eighty-five dollars extra over eight hundred and sixty-six days.
Earning interest doesn't guarantee immediate access to your money.
Here, Aave's available cash fell sharply. That's a withdrawal constraint, not a measured loss.
Better interfaces should compare net yield, explain withdrawal risk, and reduce avoidable costs.
